caveats: Software-consumed sequential ADC results, not an oscilloscope waveform.
zc means zcfoundroutine entry: variant A also calls it after forced timeout; correlate with accepted ADC samples.
elapsed/interval/wait use 0.5 us ticks; current is filtered centiamps, voltage centivolts.
flags indicate commanded direction, NOT measured rotor direction.
First records plus ring tail; gaps are omitted/overwritten history, not missing ADC interrupts.
cycle maxima measure only inner logger work, not full ISR or total overhead.
The 2 s capture cap stops logging only, never the motor. No hardware-validation claim.

Last 16 summaries. Trace capture_id is the trial id; each start replaces a non-failure trace, first failed trial remains pinned until explicit ARM. Closed-loop stage alone is not proof of normal loaded operation.
Observed times are service timestamps, not physical zero-cross timestamps. Current is a filtered software maximum, not peak phase current.
S2: acquisition <= 300 ms; only six-edge handoff earns <= 1 s observation; first runtime timeout aborts. Not a hardware current limiter, native stuck-trip proof or flight mode.
